authority.secret_authority: Vault remains the future secret-material authority
authority.broker_authority: action-runner broker returns opaque lease capability only
authority.authorization_authority: Anar-Core decision receipt with ALLOW and matching scope
authority.plaintext_secret_material: not present in application types or test outputs

contract.reference: organization- and purpose-scoped secret reference; not a credential or authorization
contract.request: subject, operation, purpose, reference, and Anar-Core decision receipt
contract.scope: decision organization and purpose must match reference and request
contract.lease: Vault-issued non-empty lease ID and explicit expiry
contract.capability: opaque lease ID, reference, organization, purpose, operation, expiry
contract.failure: missing approval, scope mismatch, revoked/failed Vault lease, or malformed lease fails closed
